## Kinema 1.4

- **Pause downloads.** The Downloads tab has **Pause All** / **Resume All** above what's downloading, and a pause / play button on each download (also when you hold it). Paused downloads keep what they've got and stay paused after Kinema closes.
- **Mobile data is respected.** With Settings → Downloads → Download on mobile data off, downloads now wait for Wi-Fi: when Kinema starts, when you leave Wi-Fi in the middle of a download, and also while Kinema is closed in the background. Turning it on lets waiting downloads carry on.
- **Subtitles you find online reach your downloads.** A subtitle found with Find Subtitles in the player is saved with the download of that episode or film, and subtitles added on the server later are saved the next time you play the download with a connection. Find Subtitles now also works while playing a download, and holding a download offers **Get New Subtitles**. Switch it with Settings → Downloads → **Add subtitles found later**.
- **Player buttons stay centred.** Play sits in the middle even when there's no previous or next episode (on the first or last episode).
- **Portrait works properly.** In portrait the middle buttons move closer together and the tools along the bottom become icons, so nothing is squashed or cut off. Choosing Portrait or Landscape in ••• now sticks, also for the next episodes, instead of flipping back after a moment or at the next episode.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later).
